web_bottleneck: Company bottleneck is manufacturing scale and cost: Q2 2026 cost of revenue exceeds revenue, gross loss $1.166M (SEC 8-K 2026-08-10, primary); CFO flagged $50-100M Fab 2 upgrade capex, about $75M, not spent this year (transcript 2026-08-10). web_who_benefits_next: Second and third order: photonics and TFLN supply chain plus packaging partners; NATO and allied defense integrators via Planck Dynamics (PRNewswire 2026-06-18); universities and the Qatar ecosystem via HBKU (2026-09-15); foundry customers needing U.S. advanced packaging. Bullish analysts now include Titan, Ascendiant, Rosenblatt, Lake Street, Northland (2026-08 and 2026-09).
web_who_loses: If room-temperature photonic quantum wins, cryogenic quantum hardware vendors lose (IonQ, D-Wave, Rigetti per sector coverage 2026-09-23 gdelt, aggregator). Classical cybersecurity and QKD incumbents lose if QCi entanglement-based Quantum Identity Authentication replaces classical authentication (PRNewswire 2026-09-21). Centralized cloud and GPU compute loses edge-AI share to NeuraWave.

web_did_they_deliver: Partly. Fab 2 launched ahead of schedule after the NHanced close on 2026-06-23; NeuraWave reached commercial readiness in Q2 2026; Dirac-3 was sold, delivered and installed at a global consulting firm in June 2026; Planck Dynamics gave an initial order for five NeuraWave systems (PRNewswire 2026-06-18). Revenue rose to $5.6M in Q2 2026 (SEC 8-K 2026-08-10).
web_what_would_falsify: A Q3 2026 report (next expected around November 2026, date unconfirmed) showing consolidated gross margin still negative AND sequential revenue flat once acquisitions are excluded would falsify the growth thesis, as would NHanced legacy lines continuing to shrink or a goodwill impairment.
